create.name: Isis Indriya
create.bio:
Isis Indriya is a ritualist, diviner and teacher of the oracle arts. Born in Mesa, Arizona and raised on Guam, where her family's roots are Indigenous, she lost her mother when she was four, and that early loss turned her towards the ancestors and the unseen. She came to the mainland United States at seventeen to study mythology and breathwork, which opened onto ancient mystery traditions, the sacred sciences and Earth-based wisdom. For more than twenty years she has created ceremonial space, from private sessions to large rituals held alongside elders and wisdom keepers from many cultures.

She founded the Academy of Oracle Arts, which runs online and in-person study from its home at Studio Omari in Nevada City, California. Her own teaching centres on Egyptian cosmology and the Neteru, the Hermetic Tree of Life, divination, and ritual as a craft. She reads with an oracle divination board she brought into being in 2017, a cosmological map linked to a crystal ball, and she leads a ten-month apprenticeship in ritual leadership along with pilgrimages to Egypt. Her recorded courses can be taken at home, while her immersions and community prayers gather people in person. She describes her role as minister and fireplace keeper for a community she calls the Oracle Clan.

courses.title: Oracle Board Divination Reading
courses.description: A private reading with the oracle divination board she created, a cosmological map of planetary, elemental and archetypal symbols linked to a crystal ball. You may bring a question or ask for a general reading, and she may suggest a ritual to go with it.

courses.title: Building a Relationship with the Neteru
courses.description: A five-module recorded course on the divinities of ancient Egypt and how to approach them through study and devotion. Replays and materials stay available online.

courses.title: Intro to the Tree of Life: Communing with the Blueprint of Creation
courses.description: Six recorded sessions introducing the Tree of Life from the Hermetic Qabalah. The course links its structure to practical spiritual work and to her teaching on divination.

courses.title: Gateways to Ancient Egypt/Kemet
courses.description: A four-module recorded course with Marza Millar on the temples of ancient Egypt, how they were used and the divine principles they honoured. Lifetime access to the recordings is included.

courses.title: Emergence of Venus
courses.description: Seven pre-recorded sessions with Baelyn Elspeth and Rachel Rossito exploring the myths, philosophy and planetary cycles of Venus. It combines conversation, contemplation, craft and poetry as ritual practice.
